name: Cathode
author: Erin Carter
description: An old CRT tube — colour test-bars scrolling behind a barrel-curved screen, fine scanlines and an RGB aperture-grille mask over everything, a vsync roll bar sweeping down and the picture flickering inside a dark bezel. Retro, electronic, alive.

params.label: Curvature
params.effect: Barrel bow of the screen; 0 is flat, high bulges the tube and pulls in the bezel.

params.label: Scanlines
params.effect: Darkening of alternate scan rows; 0 is a clean picture, high is heavy line structure.

params.label: Phosphor
params.effect: Strength of the RGB aperture-grille colour mask; high gives a visible phosphor triad.

params.label: Roll
params.effect: Speed of the vsync roll bar sweeping down the screen; 0 holds it still.

params.label: Mouse influence
params.effect: How strongly the pointer brightens the tube near it; 0 ignores the mouse.
